generalCriterionList.description: Tenders  from Joint ventures are not acceptable.

Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka
Bidders shall ensure upload of relevant document certifying his/her status as Scheduled Caste/ Scheduled Tribe/other reserved category as prescribed in the tender document.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Bidders shall strictly upload only the documents required under the tender conditions. No additional, irrelevant or unsolicited documents shall be uploaded.

Achieved, in at least two financial years, a minimum annual financial turnover of Rs. 600.00 lakh (Rupees Six Crore only) in civil engineering construction works. technicalCriterionList.description: Satisfactorily completed, as a prime contractor, at least one similar work of value not less than Rs. 150.00 lakh (Rupees One Crore Fifty Lakh only), equivalent to 50% of the estimated cost, subject to confirmation of its permissibility under applicable Government Orders.Similar works shall mean construction of community toilets, public toilet complexes, sanitary blocks, public buildings, institutional buildings or comparable building works involving civil construction and associated water supply, plumbing and sanitary installations.

The tenderer shall demonstrate availability of liquid assets and/or credit facilities of not less than Rs. 90.00 lakh (Rupees Ninety Lakh only) from nationalised or scheduled banks for meeting the financial requirements of the work. The bankers certificate should be submitted as per the below format only.

Executed during any one year (continuous period of 12 months), the following minimum quantities of work 1.Earthwork excavation, including foundation excavation-801.40 Cum, 2. Concrete work, including PCC and RCC-303.19 Cum, 3. Structural steel work, including tubular trusses and built-up steel sections-9.91 MT,4. TMT reinforcement steel work-20.30 MT,5.Solid concrete block masonry / equivalent masonry wall work- 1,654.79 Sqm,6.Cement plastering work-3,776.06 Sqm and 7.Laying of ceramic/glazed tiles, including flooring, skirting and dadoing-1,717.52 Sqm
